All tools/Word Counter

Word Counter

Get a little more insight into every word.

Your files stay yours. All processing happens on your device.

How to use this tool

  1. Type or paste your Arabic or English text.
  2. Read live word, character, sentence and paragraph counts.
  3. Copy your text or results.

Good to know

How is reading time calculated?

Reading time is an estimate at 200 words per minute. Sentence counts use punctuation and are approximate. Characters count Unicode code points, including combining marks.

Are my files or text uploaded?

Processing happens in your browser. Toolora does not send your files or text to a server. Close the page to clear the tool session.
